type: machine-readable schema for E&C-BORN-01 route records
freeze_status: FROZEN — fields and vocabularies may not be extended after case work begins
note: No field is populated during freeze. Allowed values are declared; judgments occur only in the separately authorized execution phase.

target_claims.rule: each target assessed independently; no cross-target credit transfer

exact_assumptions.rule: every axiom/postulate/structural assumption required by the proof; classified not merely listed

relation_to_Cbp_boundary.frozen_rule: scope information only; not disconfirmation unless route demonstrably lies within the theorem's premises and claims the same target

criticisms_and_replies.rule: primary-source objections + replies; disputes preserved, never averaged

two_directional_attack.rule: both attacks mandatory per route; surviving both with independent premises earns a positive disposition

hard_firewalls_frozen: collapse models supply weights BY POSTULATE unless stochastic measure derived
reproduction of statistics != explanation of weights
mathematical measure uniqueness != physical origin of objective probability
inherited_artifacts_role: CONTEXT ONLY — 10681b0, 8ebac8b, 793143e, 7b22da8, 7c8048b, DP-R0-01 set; conclusions not usable as classification evidence
out_of_scope: quarantined rewrite set and malformed JSONs
